text: Just discovered this amazing new app called Lumosity for brain training! Perfect for kids who need extra practice. Check it out at https://www.lumosity.com 🧠 #edtech #learning

Our homeschool community is loving the new curriculum from Sonlight. Great for K-8 reading and history programs!

Visit: http://sonlight.com/curriculum
The Khan Academy math track for middle school has improved SO much. My daughter finally gets fractions now! https://www.khanacademy.org/math #math #middle_school
If you're looking for coding activities for your elementary students, try Code.org's Computer Science fundamentals course. Free and no login required!
Found this gem: Beast Academy by Art of Problem Solving is great for gifted kids in grades 2-8. The online practice is excellent.
Outschool has an incredible variety of classes for curious kids — from creative writing to robotics to marine biology. So many options that fit every learning style! https://outschool.com/classes
Teachers Pay Teachers is gold. Every resource I need for my 3rd grade classroom is there. Highly recommend finding a teacher whose style matches yours.
